text: lash the broken sword blade crosswise to the end of the ash pole with soaked rawhide to make a heavy bill-hook polearm
reason: You soak the rawhide strips in the trough, then bind the broken blade crosswise to the end of the ash pole. The wet strips tighten as they dry, holding the heavy polearm together, though the crosswise blade puts strain on the binding.
